target_fidelity.note: It is a present-simple active positive polar question with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The prompt and resulting question are coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It focuses clearly on forming a present-simple yes/no question with do-support.

determinacy.note: The supplied words and instruction determine the intended question form; the prompt supplies the final question mark.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and situation are common and unambiguous.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt provides cue words but not the completed question form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving it requires only the targeted present-simple question formation.
